IC1: 1. For subjects in Cohort A: previous therapy for more than 48 hours with any parenteral antibiotic with activity against S. aureus within 72 hours of positive blood culture results.
IC2: 2. For subjects in Cohort B: previous therapy for more than 48 hours with any parenteral antibiotic with activity against MRSA, [NOT] [NOT] except vancomycin and/or daptomycin, within 72 hours of positive blood culture results confirming persistence.
IC3: 3. Previous episode of S. aureus bacteremia within 3 months.
IC4: 4. Known left-sided endocarditis [OR] or prosthetic heart valve.
IC5: 5. Osteomyelitis [OR] or prosthetic joint infection [NOT] except new onset nonhardware-associated vertebral osteomyelitis.
IC6: 6. History of any hypersensitivity [OR] or allergic reaction [AND] to any β-lactam antibacterial agent.
IC7: 7. Evidence of significant hepatic [OR], hematologic [OR], or immunologic impairment.
